section.p: The Motor Temperature (tempm) is the motor frame temperature measured by the SMS. The temperature sensor on the inside side (towards the motor) measures the motor temperature.
The recorded data shows the motor temperature scatter plot data, in the unit of Celsius (°C). The analytics system can use this data to detect the electrical or mechanical failures.
Each record contains an array of two samples captured on the specified timestamp.
For more information on API refer to the ADI OtoSense™ SMS REST API.
